judge_notes.opus5: Montage's 20 October pre-announcement (+20.9% QoQ interconnect, Q4 demand rising further) was published in Chinese and not carried into any English Rambus preview, against a guide asking +14% QoQ (i0); but only ~3% of revenue is incremental to the guide, the forward 2027 RDIMM-unit thesis is what has sold the last four prints (i2), and put skew is bid - so a small positive.
judge_notes.opus55: Montage's Chinese-language pre-announcement (interconnect +21% QoQ, Q4 demand up) read through to Rambus product revenue above its +14% guide, on a stock down 18% in October; the 2027 RDIMM unit bear case and four straight negative prints temper it.
judge_notes.sonnet55: Montage's Q3 pre-announcement (+21% QoQ) points to a beat but Rambus sold its last four prints on the 2027 unit narrative and puts are bid.
judge_notes.fable51: Montage's Chinese-language pre-announcement of +21% QoQ interconnect revenue with Q4 rising further, not carried into any English preview, against a Rambus product guide of +14% and a stock that fell after it; the 2027 RDIMM-unit bear case that moved the last four prints caps it.
